name: Pia Celestino
headline: Founder. Brand Strategist & Creative Director @ Suma. TEDx Speaker.
about:
Pia Celestino is the founder and creative director at Crea7ive, a digital agency based in Miami, FL focused in Millennial and multicultural markets with a portfolio of clients including Wendy's, Disney, Kraft, Armani Casa, Zumba and Dreamworks. Crea7ive is part of the .1% of creative agencies founded by women. In 2012, Pia co-launched EyeTalker, a startup that developed a pair of glasses with wearable tech to help the visually impaired “hear” printed text on any media. Pia's endeavors have been featured in Inc. Magazine, Forbes and TEDx. She graduated from Florida International University with a degree in Communications and Business and is passionate about design, technology and impact entrepreneurship.

experiences.description: Pia Celestino is the founder and creative director of Suma, a Miami-based branding and digital advertising agency that's worked with brands like Wendy's, Disney, Kraft, Armani Casa, Zumba and Dreamworks.

Pia is also one of the co-founders of EyeTalker, a project that developed a pair of glasses with a camera that captures printed text and delivers it as audio to the visually impaired. The glasses help the visually impaired “hear” printed text on books, newspapers, magazines, menus, and more to help them gain a higher level of dignity, freedom, independence and quality of life.
